title: Pro Yakyuu Team mo Tsukurou!
native_title: プロ野球チームもつくろう！
overview:
The third title in the Tsukurou series. Build your own pro baseball team too!!

- Create your very own original players in "Make Players Too!" mode! The players you create appear in the game, and they're sure to be stars!?
- Use your team's password and you can even play against your friends' teams!
- Manage the club and strengthen your players... Raise them properly and aim for the strongest club in the world!!
- A super-deluxe lineup of guests too!!

つくろうシリーズ第3弾。プロ野球チームもつくっちゃおう!!

●「選手もつくろう！」モードでキミだけのオリジナル選手をつくっちゃおう！つくった選手はゲームに登場、大活躍まちがいなし!?
●キミのチームのパスワードを使えば、友達のチームと対戦もできちゃうぞ！
●球団運営・選手の強化・・・。きちんと育てて、世界最強の球団をめざそう!!
●ゲスト陣も超豪華!!
